description: Agent runbook for evaluating an existing PDB directory through the separately installed first-party Proteina-Complexa CLI. Use to refold or score designs, compute interface pAE, i_pLDDT, scRMSD, motif RMSD, or designability, run complexa analysis, or assess third-party BindCraft, AlphaProteo, or RFdiffusion outputs. SKILL.md selects and invokes the evaluation configuration; bundled executables only inspect local readiness and write a run manifest.
